require 'socket'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module ChatServer
  PROXY_MODE = ENV.fetch('CHAT_PROXY_MODE', 'reverse')
  MAX_HEADER_SIZE = ENV.fetch('CHAT_MAX_HEADER', '8192').to_i

  class Connection
    attr_reader :socket, :id, :buffer

    def initialize(socket)
      @socket = socket
      @id = SecureRandom.hex(8)
      @buffer = ''
      @authenticated = false
      @username = nil
    end

    def authenticated?
      @authenticated
    end

    def authenticate(username)
      @username = username
      @authenticated = true
    end
  end

  class RequestParser
    def initialize(connection)
      @conn = connection
      @state = :request_line
      @headers = {}
      @body = ''
      @content_length = 0
      @chunked = false
      @method = nil
      @path = nil
    end

    def parse_headers(raw_headers)
      @headers = {}
      raw_headers.each_line do |line|
        line.strip!
        next if line.empty?
        key, value = line.split(':', 2)
        next unless key && value
        normalized_key = key.strip.downcase
        # RFC 7230: handle multiple header values
        if @headers[normalized_key]
          @headers[normalized_key] = [@headers[normalized_key]].flatten << value.strip
        else
          @headers[normalized_key] = value.strip
        end
      end
      @headers
    end

    def determine_body_length
      te_header = @headers['transfer-encoding']
      cl_header = @headers['content-length']

      # RFC 7230 Section 3.3.3: If both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length
      # are present, this is an attempt at request smuggling. Reject it.
      if te_header && cl_header
        raise "Ambiguous body framing: both Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length present"
      elsif te_header
        resolve_with_transfer_encoding(te_header)
      elsif cl_header
        resolve_with_content_length(cl_header)
      else
        @content_length = 0
        @chunked = false
      end
    end

    def resolve_with_transfer_encoding(te_value)
      encodings = te_value.is_a?(Array) ? te_value.last : te_value
      # Parse the encoding chain
      encoding_list = encodings.split(',')
      final_encoding = encoding_list.last.strip.downcase
      if final_encoding == 'chunked'
        @chunked = true
        @content_length = 0
      else
        # Unknown TE without CL - no body
        @content_length = 0
        @chunked = false
      end
    end

    def resolve_with_content_length(cl_value)
      @content_length = parse_content_length(cl_value)
      @chunked = false
    end

    def parse_content_length(value)
      # Handle potential multiple CL values - reject if inconsistent
      if value.is_a?(Array)
        values = value.map(&:to_i)
        raise "Inconsistent Content-Length values" unless values.uniq.size == 1
        values.first
      else
        val = value.to_i
        raise "Invalid Content-Length" if val < 0
        val
      end
    end

    def read_body(raw_data)
      if @chunked
        read_chunked_body(raw_data)
      else
        raw_data[0, @content_length]
      end
    end

    def read_chunked_body(data)
      result = ''
      remaining = data
      loop do
        break if remaining.empty?
        chunk_header_end = remaining.index("\r\n")
        break unless chunk_header_end
        # Parse chunk size - note: we only parse hex digits before any extension
        chunk_size_str = remaining[0, chunk_header_end]
        chunk_size = chunk_size_str.to_i(16)
        break if chunk_size == 0
        chunk_start = chunk_header_end + 2
        chunk_data = remaining[chunk_start, chunk_size]
        result << chunk_data
        remaining = remaining[(chunk_start + chunk_size + 2)..-1] || ''
      end
      result
    end

    def parse_request(raw)
      lines = raw.split("\r\n\r\n", 2)
      header_section = lines[0]
      body_section = lines[1] || ''

      request_line = header_section.lines.first.strip
      @method, @path, _ = request_line.split(' ', 3)

      raw_headers = header_section.lines[1..-1].join
      parse_headers(raw_headers)
      determine_body_length

      @body = read_body(body_section)

      { method: @method, path: @path, headers: @headers, body: @body }
    end
  end

  class Server
    def initialize(host = '0.0.0.0', port = 8080)
      @host = host
      @port = port
      @connections = {}
      @channels = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }
      @messages = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = [] }
    end

    def start
      server = TCPServer.new(@host, @port)
      puts "Chat server running on #{@host}:#{@port} [mode=#{PROXY_MODE}]"

      loop do
        client = server.accept
        Thread.new(client) { |sock| handle_client(sock) }
      end
    end

    def handle_client(socket)
      conn = Connection.new(socket)
      @connections[conn.id] = conn

      loop do
        raw = read_full_request(socket)
        break unless raw

        parser = RequestParser.new(conn)
        request = parser.parse_request(raw)
        response = route_request(conn, request)
        socket.write(response)
      end
    rescue => e
      puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    ensure
      @connections.delete(conn&.id)
      socket&.close
    end

    def read_full_request(socket)
      data = ''
      loop do
        chunk = socket.recv_nonblock(4096)
        return nil if chunk.nil? || chunk.empty?
        data << chunk
        # Enforce header size limit to prevent unbounded memory
        # exhaustion (DoS) when no CRLFCRLF terminator is ever sent.
        if data.bytesize > MAX_HEADER_SIZE && !data.include?("\r\n\r\n")
          raise "Request headers exceed maximum allowed size (#{MAX_HEADER_SIZE} bytes)"
        end
        break if data.include?("\r\n\r\n")
      end
      data
    rescue IO::WaitReadable
      IO.select([socket], nil, nil, 30)
      retry
    rescue EOFError
      nil
    end

    def route_request(conn, request)
      case request[:path]
      when '/chat/send'
        handle_send(conn, request)
      when '/chat/join'
        handle_join(conn, request)
      when '/chat/poll'
        handle_poll(conn, request)
      when '/health'
        http_response(200, { status: 'ok' })
      else
        http_response(404, { error: 'not found' })
      end
    end

    def handle_join(conn, request)
      body = JSON.parse(request[:body]) rescue {}
      username = body['username']
      channel = body['channel'] || 'general'

      return http_response(400, { error: 'username required' }) unless username

      conn.authenticate(username)
      @channels[channel] << conn.id
      http_response(200, { joined: channel, user: username })
    end

    def handle_send(conn, request)
      return http_response(401, { error: 'not authenticated' }) unless conn.authenticated?

      body = JSON.parse(request[:body]) rescue {}
      message = body['message']
      channel = body['channel'] || 'general'

      return http_response(400, { error: 'message required' }) unless message

      @messages[channel] << { user: conn.id, text: message, ts: Time.now.to_i }
      http_response(200, { sent: true })
    end

    def handle_poll(conn, request)
      channel = request[:headers]['x-channel'] || 'general'
      since = (request[:headers]['x-since'] || '0').to_i
      msgs = @messages[channel].select { |m| m[:ts] > since }
      http_response(200, { messages: msgs })
    end

    def http_response(status, body)
      json = JSON.generate(body)
      "HTTP/1.1 #{status} OK\r\n" \
      "Content-Type: application/json\r\n" \
      "Content-Length: #{json.bytesize}\r\n" \
      "Connection: keep-alive\r\n" \
      "\r\n" \
      "#{json}"
    end
  end
end

ChatServer::Server.new.start if __FILE__ == $0
